Cobham Montessori School
Education for life
Welcome to Cobham Montessori School
Cobham Montessori School is an independent school situated close to the centre of Cobham. We serve 35 children (and their families) from 2.5 to 11 years, in the tradition of the Association Montessori Internationale (AMI). Our purpose is to aid each child's natural development through their preschool and primary school years.
"Free the Child's potential and you transform him into the world"
-Maria Montessori
About Montessori
Maria Montessori (1870-1952) was an Italian physician and educator who founded a philosophy of education that builds upon a child's natural path of development. Her lifelong observation of children and scientific study of pedagogy established an approach to learning which emphasises independence, self-directed activity, cooperation and learning in harmony with each child's unique pace of development.
"One test of the correctness of educational procedure
is the happiness of the child." - Maria Montessori
Further information on the Montessori approach may be seen on the Montessori society website:
http://www.montessorisociety.org.uk/

Cobham Montessori School
Education for life
About our school
Our School is guided by the Montessori principles and philosphy. We provide an environment which supports each individual child to make independent choices and develop self-dicipline. Our aim is to produce happy, self-confident children filled with a desire to learn and a love of learning that will carry and support them all the way through their school years and into adulthood.
We provide a wide range of experiences which, in a gentle, sympathetic and encouraging way stimulates each child’s innate love of learning and discovery. Each child is treated with respect and given the freedom to learn within the limits of a carefully structured environment which allows the child to develop naturally.
What do our parents think?
"Cobham Montessori is a fantastic place for children to learn and grow. The environment allows the children to explore not only academic and social skills but also emotional development. The range of activities and working materials is truly excellent. The teachers care passionately about what they do! This is reflected in how happy our children are to go to school every day!"
We have 2 connected communities in our school - our Children's House for children from 30 months to 6 years and our Elementary class which offers full-time education to children aged 6-11.
New children start in whichever group is best suited to their stage of development which we discuss with parents after we have met the child. In supporting each child's natural development we are led by Montessori principles and practice, following the training and guidance of the Association Montessori Internationale.
Additionally, children have access to a large, secure outdoor area where there is an "all-weather" surface play area, a small kitchen garden where the children grow fruits and vegetables, as well as a sizeable lawned garden where we have a mud kitchen, a small pond and various climbing equipment. Children are encouraged to work outside if they wish.
The School Day
We operate as a term-time Montessori School.
The Children's House enjoy morning sessions from 8.45am-12.00pm followed by lunch ending at 1.00pm. The Children's House have afternoon sessions until 3:15pm with varying activities from cooking, Yoganory and sports which are provided by specialist external teachers. These classes are included in our fees.
Children's House close early on a Friday after sports at 1:40pm.
Elementary is full-time from 8.30am-3.15pm every day, with afternoon sessions of sports, yoga, forest school, Spanish and optional Mandarin lessons during the school week - also included in our fees.
Children all eat their packed lunch together as a community and it is an excellent opportunity to interact socially and build relationships.

Admissions
Thank you for your interest in our school!
We consider all children for admission to the school who have the ability to benefit from our Montessori curriculum which encourages children to develop a high degree of independence in their own learning.
Our admissions process is outlined below and we encourage you to review our admissions policy and our fees: Fees for 2024-25, Fees 2025-26, Fees 2026-27.
Admissions Process
The first step in our admissions process is to complete the form below to indicate your interest in our school.
Next, attend a Parents' Information Session to gain a good understanding of Montessori and our school-we host these each term.
Parents complete the Application Form, pay the Application Fee and send us any reports in order to join our waitlist.
Once a place becomes available, we will arrange a suitable date for your child to have a taster visit or taster day (for older children).
Following their taster visit, an offer of place will be made if our School is suited to your child.
